title: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
title_zh: 超越下游问答：重新思考智能体记忆的评估方式

paragraphs.en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent’s responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems. 1 1 1 https://github.com/amazon-science/feb-30-benchmark
paragraphs.zh: 智能体记忆基准测试评估智能体的响应是否反映了正确的知识，通过衡量下游问答任务的准确率来间接反映记忆质量。 我们发现这种评估范式并不完整：它将记忆的准确性与检索和生成质量混为一谈，既产生了正确响应掩盖了记忆缺陷的假阳性结果，也产生了错误响应将检索失败归咎于正确记忆的假阴性结果。 我们提出了 FEB-30，一个包含 30 条事实演化轨迹的基准测试，涵盖 6 个诊断类别和 3 个难度等级。该基准通过范式反转构建：从已知的事实演化轨迹生成文档，从而获得无需人工标注的确定性标准答案。 每条轨迹定义了某个事实应如何在多位作者创作的成果（文档、邮件、对话）中逐步演化，这使得我们能够在每次信息摄入后直接检查记忆存储的状态。 我们将 FEB-30 应用于一个典型的记忆系统，结果表明内在评估与外在评估的平均差异达到了 16 个百分点，且有 44% 的轨迹超过了有意义的差异阈值。 诊断性分解显示，该系统仅能在 20% 的情况下正确分类记忆操作（创建、更新、强化、替代），而这一缺陷在外在评估中完全无法察觉；此外，不同类别和难度下的故障模式也存在系统性差异。 我们公开了该基准测试、文档生成流程以及评分框架，以支持对智能体记忆系统的可重复评估。1 1 1 https://github.com/amazon-science/feb-30-benchmark

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents operating over extended time horizons require persistent external memory to accumulate knowledge beyond the ephemeral context window ( Sumers et al. 2024 ; Jiang et al. 2026 ) . As these systems grow more complex, with over a dozen distinct architectures published since 2023 ( Latimer et al. 2026 ; Packer et al. 2024 ; Rasmussen et al. 2025 ; Chhikara et al. 2025 ; Zhu et al. 2026 ) , the question of how to evaluate them becomes pressing.
paragraphs.zh: 在长时间跨度内运行的语言模型（LLM）智能体需要持续的外部记忆，以积累超越短暂上下文窗口的知识（Sumers 等，2024；Jiang 等，2026）。 随着这些系统变得越来越复杂，自 2023 年以来已有超过十种不同的架构被发表（Latimer 等，2026；Packer 等，2024；Rasmussen 等，2025；Chhikara 等，2025；Zhu 等，2026），如何评估它们的问题变得日益紧迫。

paragraphs.en: A survey of current benchmarks reveals a systematic limitation: every existing evaluation measures memory quality extrinsically , by posing questions to the agent and grading its responses ( Maharana et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2026 ; Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026 ; Uddin et al. 2026 ; Liu and Yadav 2026 ; Jung et al. 2026 ) . This produces a single composite score that conflates memory, retrieval, and generation quality. When the system fails, one cannot identify which component is responsible; when it succeeds, one cannot confirm the memory is actually correct ( Toma and Matei 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对当前基准测试的考察揭示了一个系统性局限：所有现有的评估方法都通过向智能体提问并评分其回答，从外部角度衡量记忆质量（Maharana 等人，2024；Wu 等人，2026；Hu、Wang 和 McAuley，2026；Uddin 等人，2026；Liu 和 Yadav，2026；Jung 等人，2026）。 这种方法产生了一个单一的复合分数，将记忆、信息检索和生成质量混为一谈。 当系统失败时，无法确定是哪个组件出了问题；而当系统成功时，也无法确认记忆内容是否确实正确（Toma 和 Matei，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We identify two concrete failure modes that extrinsic evaluation cannot detect:
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出两种外在评估无法检测到的具体失效模式：

paragraphs.en: False positives (LLM compensation): A strong generation model can produce correct responses despite incorrect or incomplete memory state, by reasoning over partial retrieval results at inference time. Extrinsic evaluation scores this as success.
paragraphs.zh: 假阳性（LLM 补偿）：一个强大的生成模型即便记忆状态不正确或不完整，也能在推理时基于部分检索结果进行推理，从而生成正确的响应。 外在评估将这种情况视为成功。

sents.en: False positives (LLM compensation): A strong generation model can produce correct responses despite incorrect or incomplete memory state, by reasoning over partial retrieval results at inference time.
sents.zh: 假阳性（LLM 补偿）：一个强大的生成模型即便记忆状态不正确或不完整，也能在推理时基于部分检索结果进行推理，从而生成正确的响应。

sents.en: Extrinsic evaluation scores this as success.
sents.zh: 外在评估将这种情况视为成功。

paragraphs.en: False negatives (retrieval bottleneck): A memory system may correctly store and update facts, yet fail to retrieve them for a specific query due to embedding mismatch or retrieval cutoff. Extrinsic evaluation blames the memory system for a retrieval failure.
paragraphs.zh: 假阴性（检索瓶颈）：一个记忆系统可能正确存储和更新事实，但由于嵌入不匹配或检索阈值限制，仍可能在特定查询中无法检索到这些事实。 外在评估将检索失败归咎于记忆系统本身。

paragraphs.en: We propose intrinsic evaluation , direct comparison of the memory store contents against known ground truth at each stage of knowledge evolution, as a complementary evaluation paradigm. The relationship mirrors unit versus end-to-end testing in software engineering: intrinsic evaluation checks the memory component’s internal state directly, while extrinsic evaluation only observes end-to-end behavior, so a passing end-to-end test can mask a broken component just as a correct component can fail end-to-end due to an integration bottleneck. A parallel from NLP history motivates the same shift: in the 2010s, word embeddings were evaluated only through downstream task performance until intrinsic evaluation (analogy tasks, similarity correlations) enabled faster progress by isolating representation quality ( Baroni, Dinu, and Kruszewski 2014 ; Schnabel et al. 2015 ) . Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一种内在评估方法，即在知识演化的每个阶段，将记忆存储内容直接与已知的基准真相进行比较，以此作为补充的评估范式。 这种关系类似于软件工程中的单元测试与端到端测试：内在评估直接检查记忆组件的内部状态，而外在评估仅观察端到端行为，因此，即使端到端测试通过，也可能掩盖了某个组件的故障；同样，一个正确的组件也可能因集成瓶颈而在端到端测试中失败。 自然语言处理发展史中的一个类似案例也支持这种转变：在 2010 年代，词嵌入仅通过下游任务的性能进行评估，直到内在评估（类比任务、相似性相关性分析）的出现，通过隔离表示质量本身，推动了更快的进展（Baroni, Dinu, and Kruszewski 2014；Schnabel et al. 2015）。我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: MemoryAgentBench ( Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026 ) defines four memory competencies (retention, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and information integration) evaluated through QA interactions. Memora ( Uddin et al. 2026 ) introduces the FAMA metric that penalizes reliance on invalidated memories, decomposing performance into freshness-aware components. LongMemEval-V2 ( Wu et al. 2026 ) tests long-term memory along five temporal reasoning capabilities. AMA-Bench ( Zhao et al. 2026 ) evaluates long-horizon memory for agentic applications. STATE-Bench ( Liu and Yadav 2026 ) measures whether agents improve at tasks through accumulated experience. MEME ( Jung et al. 2026 ) introduces controlled state trajectories with multi-entity evolution, the closest methodology to ours, though still evaluated through the response layer.
paragraphs.zh: MemoryAgentBench（Hu、Wang 和 McAuley，2026）定义了四项记忆能力（保留信息、时间推理、知识更新和信息整合），并通过问答互动进行评估。 Memora（Uddin 等，2026）提出了 FAMA 指标，该指标会对依赖已失效记忆的行为进行惩罚，并将性能分解为具备时效感知能力的多个组成部分。 LongMemEval-V2（Wu 等，2026）测试了长期记忆以及五种时间推理能力。 AMA-Bench（Zhao 等，2026）评估了智能体应用中的长周期记忆能力。 STATE-Bench（Liu 和 Yadav，2026）衡量智能体是否能够通过积累经验在任务中取得进步。 MEME（Jung 等，2026）引入了包含多实体演化的受控状态轨迹，这是与我们方法最接近的研究路径，尽管其评估仍基于响应层进行。

paragraphs.en: Recent surveys ( Jiang et al. 2026 ; Du 2026 ; Luo et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2025 ; Huang et al. 2026 ) catalog memory architectures and operations. Du et al. ( Du et al. 2025 ) define six core memory operations (consolidation, updating, indexing, forgetting, retrieval, condensation), decisions that should be evaluated at the operation level, not only through downstream responses. The Anatomy of Agentic Memory survey ( Jiang et al. 2026 ) identifies benchmark saturation as a key concern, yet proposes more extrinsic benchmarks as the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究（Jiang 等人，2026；Du，2026；Luo 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2026）对记忆架构和操作流程进行了梳理。Du 等人 （Du 等人，2025）定义了六种核心记忆操作（整合、更新、索引、遗忘、检索、浓缩），这些决策应在操作层面进行评估，而不仅仅通过下游响应来评判。 《智能体记忆的解剖》研究（Jiang 等人，2026）指出基准测试的饱和是一个关键问题，但同时也提出了更多外在基准作为解决方案。

paragraphs.en: ConflictBank ( Su et al. 2024 ) benchmarks LLM behavior under knowledge conflicts but evaluates at query time, not at the memory consolidation stage. MAGIC ( Lee, Lee, and Kim 2025 ) tests multi-hop conflict detection in retrieval-augmented generation. These address a related but distinct problem: they test whether a model can reason about conflicts in retrieved context, not whether a memory system correctly detects and resolves conflicts during ingestion.
paragraphs.zh: ConflictBank（Su 等人，2024）在知识冲突情境下对 LLM 的行为进行了基准测试，但其评估发生在查询阶段，而非记忆巩固阶段。 MAGIC（Lee、Lee 和 Kim，2025）检验了检索增强生成中的多跳冲突检测能力。 这些方法解决的是一个相关但不同的问题：它们测试模型能否对检索到的上下文中存在的冲突进行推理，而非测试记忆系统是否在记忆摄入阶段能够正确检测和解决冲突。

paragraphs.en: RIKER ( Roig 2025 ) introduced the concept of generating evaluation corpora from known ground truth for RAG evaluation, avoiding the expense and subjectivity of human annotation on real documents. We extend this approach to temporal fact evolution, generating multi-document sequences where ground truth is a trajectory of states rather than a static set of facts.
paragraphs.zh: RIKER（Roig 2025）提出了从已知真实答案生成评估语料库以进行 RAG 评估的概念，从而避免了在真实文档上进行人工标注所带来的高昂成本和主观性。 我们将这种方法扩展到时间事实演化领域，生成多文档序列，其中真实答案是一个状态轨迹，而非静态的事实集合。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation is well-established in NLP for embeddings ( Baroni, Dinu, and Kruszewski 2014 ; Schnabel et al. 2015 ) and parsing. The Future AGI practitioner framework ( Future AGI 2026 ) explicitly argues that direct memory store inspection is an anti-pattern. A concurrent survey ( Toma and Matei 2026 ) documents this gap systematically across 15 benchmarks, arguing for complementary intrinsic evaluation. We present the first benchmark and empirical results that validate this argument.
paragraphs.zh: 在嵌入（Baroni、Dinu 和 Kruszewski，2014；Schnabel 等，2015）和句法分析领域，内在评估与外在评估之间的区别在自然语言处理中已得到广泛认可。 《未来 AGI 实践者框架》（Future AGI，2026）明确指出，直接检查记忆存储是一种反模式。 一项同步进行的综述（Toma 和 Matei，2026）在 15 个基准测试中系统性地记录了这一差距，并主张采用互补的内在评估方法。 我们提出了首个验证这一论点的基准测试及实证结果。

paragraphs.en: FEB-30 (Fact Evolution Benchmark, 30 trajectories) is organized along diagnostic categories and difficulty levels (Section 3.4 ). The name is a deliberate analogy: February 30 is a date that does not exist, the calendar approaches it asymptotically (February 28, sometimes 29) but never reaches 30. Similarly, recent benchmarks and surveys have moved progressively closer to intrinsic evaluation, introducing memory-specific tasks ( Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026 ) , decomposing scores into memory-aware components ( Uddin et al. 2026 ) , and defining controlled state trajectories ( Jung et al. 2026 ) , yet remain on the extrinsic side of the threshold, never directly inspecting the memory store, as illustrated by ( Toma and Matei 2026 ) . FEB-30 crosses it.
paragraphs.zh: FEB-30（事实演化基准测试，30条轨迹）按照诊断类别和难度等级进行组织（第3.4节）。 这一名称是有意采用的类比：2月30日是一个不存在的日期，日历无限接近它（2月28日，有时是29日），但永远无法达到30日。 同样地，近期的基准测试和综述已逐步向内在评估靠拢，引入了记忆特定任务（Hu、Wang和McAuley 2026），将评分分解为记忆感知组件（Uddin等 2026），并定义了受控的状态轨迹（Jung等 2026），但仍处于该阈值的外在一侧，从未直接检查记忆存储，如（Toma和Matei 2026）所示。而FEB-30则跨越了这一阈值。

paragraphs.en: Each category targets a specific gap in extrinsic-only evaluation (Table 1 ):
paragraphs.zh: 每个类别都针对仅依赖外在指标评估中的特定空白（表1）：

paragraphs.en: C1 (LLM Compensation) constructs scenarios where memory state is incorrect (e.g., outdated fact not updated, contradictions unresolved) but a strong LLM still produces correct answers by reasoning over retrieved fragments, so a system that never updates its facts scores well extrinsically.
paragraphs.zh: C1（LLM 补偿）构建了一些记忆状态不正确的场景（例如，过时的事实未被更新，矛盾未被解决），但强大的 LLM 仍然能够通过推理检索到的片段片段得出正确答案，因此一个从不更新其事实的系统在外部评估中会获得高分。

paragraphs.en: C2 (Retrieval Bottleneck) constructs scenarios where facts are correctly stored but queries are phrased to produce low embedding similarity (vocabulary mismatch, different abstraction level). The memory is correct, only retrieval fails.
paragraphs.zh: C2（检索瓶颈）构建了一些场景：事实被正确存储，但查询的措辞导致嵌入相似度较低（词汇不匹配、抽象层次不同）。 记忆是正确的，只有检索失败了。

sents.en: C2 (Retrieval Bottleneck) constructs scenarios where facts are correctly stored but queries are phrased to produce low embedding similarity (vocabulary mismatch, different abstraction level).
sents.zh: C2（检索瓶颈）构建了一些场景：事实被正确存储，但查询的措辞导致嵌入相似度较低（词汇不匹配、抽象层次不同）。

sents.en: The memory is correct, only retrieval fails.
sents.zh: 记忆是正确的，只有检索失败了。

paragraphs.en: C3 (Classification Accuracy) tests whether the system correctly classifies each observation as a create, update, reinforce, or conflict operation, decisions extrinsic evaluation cannot observe directly.
paragraphs.zh: C3（分类准确率）用于检验系统能否正确地将每个观测结果归类为创建、更新、增强或冲突操作，这些决策是外部评估无法直接观察到的。

paragraphs.en: C4 (Synthesis Quality) tests whether multiple observations from different artifacts merge into correct, well-formed facts, with ground truth specifying which should form a single fact versus separate facts.
paragraphs.zh: C4（合成质量）测试多个来自不同人工制品的观察结果是否能够合并为正确且结构良好的事实，其中基准答案会明确哪些观察结果应构成单一事实，而哪些应构成独立的事实。

paragraphs.en: C5 (Temporal Correctness) tests whether the memory state correctly reflects temporal evolution: linear progression (A → \rightarrow B → \rightarrow C), retraction, and gradual drift across artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: C5（时间正确性）测试记忆状态是否正确反映了时间演化：线性推进（A → \rightarrow B → \rightarrow C）、回退以及跨人工制品的渐进漂移。

paragraphs.en: C6 (Multi-Author Attribution) tests whether source identity affects consolidation correctly: corroboration from different authors should raise confidence differently than repetition from one, and disagreement should trigger conflict detection.
paragraphs.zh: C6（多作者归因）测试源身份是否会影响正确的整合：来自不同作者的相互证实应比单一作者的重复产生不同的信心提升，而意见分歧则应触发冲突检测。

paragraphs.en: At L1 (Table 2 ), target claims appear almost verbatim in generated documents with minimal surrounding noise. At L2, claims are embedded within realistic document context and require extraction from longer passages. At L3, claims must be inferred from combinations of statements, and documents contain substantial unrelated content that could mislead extraction systems.
paragraphs.zh: 在 L1（表 2）中，目标主张几乎原封不动地出现在生成的文档中，且周围几乎没有干扰信息。 在 L2 中，主张被嵌入到逼真的文档语境中，需要从中较长的段落中提取出来。 在 L3 中，必须从多个陈述的组合中推断出主张，而文档中也包含大量无关内容，这些内容可能会误导提取系统。

paragraphs.en: Each trajectory is defined as a JSON structure specifying:
paragraphs.zh: 每条轨迹都被定义为一个 JSON 结构，其中指定了：

paragraphs.en: A unique trajectory ID, category, difficulty, and domain assignment.
paragraphs.zh: 一个唯一的轨迹 ID、类别、难度和领域分配。

paragraphs.en: A type indicating the evolution pattern (linear-evolution, contradiction, scope-expansion, retraction, stable, or gradual-drift).
paragraphs.zh: 一种表示演化模式的类型（线性演化、矛盾、范围扩展、撤回、稳定或渐进漂移）。

paragraphs.en: A sequence of states , each containing a set of atomic claims representing the expected memory contents after processing documents up to that state.
paragraphs.zh: 一系列状态，每个状态都包含一组原子性主张，这些主张代表了处理到该状态为止的文档之后预期的内存内容。

paragraphs.en: Per-state docClaims , the subset of claims that the document for that state should contain (new information only, not cumulative repetition).
paragraphs.zh: 每个状态的 docClaims，即该状态对应的文档应包含的声明子集（仅包含新信息，而非累积重复内容）。

paragraphs.en: An expected action per state transition (create, update, reinforce, conflict, or supersede).
paragraphs.zh: 每次状态转换的预期操作（创建、更新、增强、冲突或取代）。

paragraphs.en: Author role and document type metadata for multi-author trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 多作者轨迹的作者角色和文档类型元数据。

paragraphs.en: Claims are required to be atomic (one assertable proposition per claim) and self-contained (understandable without reference to other claims). This ensures scoring is unambiguous: each claim either is or is not entailed by the system’s fact store.
paragraphs.zh: 主张必须是原子的（每个主张仅包含一个可断言的命题）且自包含的（无需参考其他主张即可理解）。 这确保了评分的明确性：每个主张要么被系统的知识库所蕴含，要么不被蕴含。

paragraphs.en: The key design choice is docClaims vs. claims : documents contain only new information per state. The system must retain prior knowledge across document ingestions, testing actual memory persistence, not single-document extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 关键的设计选择在于 docClaims 与 claims 之间：每个状态下的文档仅包含新信息。 该系统必须在不同文档摄入过程中保留先验知识，这考验的是真正的记忆持久性，而非单一文档的提取能力。

paragraphs.en: FEB-30 contains 30 trajectories across 6 categories, distributed across difficulty levels (10 at L1, 10 at L2, 10 at L3). Trajectories span 6 technical domains (infrastructure, security, financial operations, machine learning, data engineering, and containers) to avoid domain-specific bias. These trajectories instantiate the benchmark in a technical and business-operations setting, but the methodology is domain-agnostic as the same paradigm-inversion construction can produce trajectories for any domain in which facts evolve across multi-author artifacts, by substituting the domain’s own topics and observation categories. The total corpus comprises 147 generated documents: 127 trajectory state documents and 20 noise documents (4 per C2 trajectory to test retrieval under distraction).
paragraphs.zh: FEB-30 包含 6 个类别中的 30 条轨迹，按难度级别分布（L1 级 10 条、L2 级 10 条、L3 级 10 条）。 这些轨迹覆盖了 6 个技术领域（基础设施、安全、金融运营、机器学习、数据工程和容器），以避免特定领域的偏见。 这些轨迹将基准测试置于技术和业务运营环境中，但其方法论与具体领域无关：通过替换目标领域自身的主题和观察类别，相同的范式反转构建方法可用于生成任何领域中因多作者产物导致事实演变的轨迹。 整个语料库包含 147 份生成的文档：127 份轨迹状态文档和 20 份噪声文档（每条 C2 轨迹对应 4 份，用于测试在干扰情况下的检索能力）。

paragraphs.en: We adopt paradigm inversion ( Roig 2025 ) : rather than annotating ground truth on real documents (expensive and subjective), we generate documents from known fact trajectories, making the trajectory itself the ground truth. Algorithm 1 formalizes the pipeline.

paragraphs.en: Documents are generated using 6 models across 5 providers, rotated per state index within each trajectory to simulate different human authors with different writing styles. No single model generates more than 30% of total documents. Following evidence that multi-source synthetic data mitigates distribution collapse ( Schaffelder and Gatt 2026 ) and reduces single-generator bias ( van Elburg, van der Putten, and Marx 2025 ) , this additionally simulates the natural stylistic variation of multi-author corpora.
paragraphs.zh: 文档由来自 5 家提供商的 6 个模型生成，并在每条轨迹中根据状态索引进行轮换，以模拟具有不同写作风格的不同人类作者。 没有任何单个模型生成的文档超过总文档量的 30%。 鉴于有证据表明，多源合成数据可以缓解分布坍缩（Schaffelder 和 Gatt，2026），并减少单一生成器的偏见（van Elburg、van der Putten 和 Marx，2025），这种方法还模拟了多作者语料库中自然存在的风格差异。

paragraphs.en: The generation models are all different from the system’s extraction model (which uses a different LLM family), avoiding the stylistic bias that inflates scores when the same model generates and extracts ( van Elburg, van der Putten, and Marx 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 所有生成模型都与系统的提取模型（该模型使用不同的 LLM 系列）不同，从而避免了由同一模型同时执行生成和提取操作所导致的风格偏见（van Elburg、van der Putten 和 Marx，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Documents follow a realism gradient across difficulty levels:
paragraphs.zh: 文档在不同难度等级上呈现出一种现实主义的梯度变化：

paragraphs.en: Style-grounded (L1/L2): An LLM generates a new document for the trajectory claims but mimics the tone, vocabulary, and structure of a real reference document.
paragraphs.zh: 风格一致（L1/L2）：大型语言模型为轨迹主张生成一份新文档，但会模仿真实参考文档的语气、词汇和结构。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid injection (L3): Claims are inserted into actual human-written documents from unrelated domains, producing text that is approximately 90% authentic.
paragraphs.zh: 混合注入（L3）：将声明插入到来自无关领域的、由人类实际撰写的文档中，生成的文本约有 90% 是真实的。

paragraphs.en: For style-grounded generation, documents are typed (meeting notes, email, architecture review, status update, executive briefing) and matched to style references from a curated set of 12 AMI meeting summaries ( Carletta et al. 2005 ) and 12 Enron emails ( Klimt and Yang 2004 ) selected for diversity in length, formality, and structure.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于风格的生成，文档的类型（会议记录、电子邮件、建筑评审、状态更新、高管简报）会与从精心挑选的 12 份 AMI 会议摘要（Carletta et al. 2005）和 12 封 Enron 电子邮件（Klimt and Yang 2004）中选取的风格参考进行匹配，这些材料在长度、正式性和结构方面都具有多样性。

paragraphs.en: Document length and noise scale with difficulty:
paragraphs.zh: 文档长度与噪声尺度随难度变化：

paragraphs.en: L1: 200–400 words, no noise claims, target claims nearly explicit.
paragraphs.zh: L1：200–400 字，无噪声性主张，目标性主张近乎明确。

paragraphs.en: L2: 400–800 words, 2–3 unrelated noise claims, target claims embedded in context.
paragraphs.zh: L2：400–800 字，包含 2–3 个无关的噪声性陈述，目标陈述嵌入在上下文之中。

paragraphs.en: L3: 600–1000 words, 4–5 noise claims, subtle and ambiguous signal.
paragraphs.zh: L3：600–1000 字，包含 4–5 个噪声主张，信号微妙且模棱两可。

paragraphs.en: For L3 trajectories, host documents are selected from unrelated domains (e.g., product design meetings, energy pipeline discussions) to ensure no semantic overlap with the trajectory topic, making scoring unambiguous: any relevant fact the system extracts must come from the injected section.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 L3 轨迹，宿主文档选自无关领域（例如，产品设计会议、能源管道讨论），以确保与轨迹主题不存在语义重叠，从而使评分无歧义：系统提取的任何相关事实都必须来自注入的部分。

paragraphs.en: The verification criterion (Algorithm 1 , line 6) requires unanimous agreement from 3 independent judge models (different from the generators), following the multi-judge grounding methodology of ( Uddin et al. 2026 ) and ( Roig 2025 ) . Each judge assesses: (1) all target claims are inferable from the document, (2) no extra factual information beyond the trajectory is introduced, and (3) the document reads naturally.
paragraphs.zh: 验证标准（算法 1，第 6 行）要求 3 个独立的评判模型（与生成模型不同）达成一致意见，遵循 (Uddin et al. 2026) 和 (Roig 2025) 提出的多评判员基础验证方法。 每个评判员需评估：(1) 所有目标主张均可从文档中推断得出；(2) 未引入任何超出轨迹范围的事实信息；以及 (3) 文档读起来自然流畅。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, documents underwent human review, with 11% requiring content corrections (forward leakage, narrative contradictions, cross-document inconsistencies, numeric mismatches) and 28% requiring scaffolding removal (code fences, LLM preamble such as “generated email about…” or “injected claims into…”) that does not affect extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，这些文档还经过了人工审核：11% 的文档需要内容修正（如信息提前泄露、叙述矛盾、跨文档不一致或数值不匹配），28% 的文档则需要移除辅助框架（如代码块、LLM 的前言部分，例如“关于……的生成邮件”或“向……中注入的声明”），这些内容不会影响信息提取。

paragraphs.en: For each trajectory, we generate diagnostic questions whose answers depend on the final memory state. The system retrieves relevant facts via its standard retrieval mechanism, then an LLM generates an answer. A judge model scores each answer as YES (1.0), PARTIAL (0.5), or NO (0.0) against the expected answer derived from ground-truth claims.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条轨迹，我们生成诊断性问题，其答案取决于最终的记忆状态。 系统通过其标准的检索机制获取相关事实，然后由一个大语言模型生成答案。 一个评判模型根据从真实数据主张中得出的预期答案，将每个答案评分为“是”（1.0）、“部分正确”（0.5）或“否”（0.0）。

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate the benchmark’s diagnostic utility, we evaluate a representative agent memory system (Figure 1 ). The system follows the dominant architectural pattern shared by virtually all contemporary memory systems, Hindsight ( Latimer et al. 2026 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al. 2025 ) , AriadneMem ( Zhu et al. 2026 ) , and commercial agent memory services alike: (1) extract structured observations from artifacts (documents, emails, meeting transcripts), (2) embed them, (3) retrieve related existing facts via vector search, (4) classify the relationship via LLM (create, update, reinforce, conflict, or skip), and (5) synthesize into evolving facts with history. This extract-embed-classify-synthesize pipeline represents the current state of the art; despite surface differences in implementation details (confidence stepping in Hindsight, entropy-aware gating in AriadneMem, Add/Update/No-op in Mem0), the core information flow is shared. The specific system is not the contribution; any system implementing this pattern could be substituted. Our goal is to demonstrate what the benchmark reveals about this class of systems, not to evaluate a particular implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了展示该基准的诊断效用，我们评估了一个具有代表性的智能体记忆系统（图 1）。 该系统遵循几乎所有当代记忆系统所共用的主流架构模式，包括 Hindsight (Latimer et al. 2026)、Mem0 (Chhikara et al. 2025)、AriadneMem (Zhu et al. 2026) 以及各类商业智能体记忆服务：(1) 从人工制品（文档、电子邮件、会议记录）中提取结构化观察信息；(2) 对其进行嵌入；(3) 通过向量搜索检索相关的既有事实；(4) 利用大语言模型对关系进行分类（创建、更新、强化、冲突或跳过）；以及 (5) 结合历史信息合成不断演化的事实。 这种“提取-嵌入-分类-合成”的流程代表了当前的技术前沿；尽管各系统在实现细节上存在表面差异（如 Hindsight 中的置信度分步处理、AriadneMem 中的熵感知门控机制、Mem0 中的添加/更新/无操作机制），但其核心的信息流动是相同的。 具体使用的系统并非本文的贡献；任何采用该架构模式的系统都可以替代当前方案。 我们的目标是展示该基准对这类系统的揭示，而非评估某个特定的实现版本。

paragraphs.en: We adopt a two-layer terminology: observations are static, atomic factual statements extracted from a single artifact (typed into categories such as decisions, commitments, or milestones), while facts are the evolving, synthesized knowledge units that the system maintains over time. Observations are immutable once extracted; facts are the persistent memory that gets created, reinforced, updated, or superseded as new observations arrive. Not all observations aggregate into facts: some are too granular or transient (e.g., a one-time action item), and evaluating observations in isolation would only measure extraction completeness and atomicity, not whether the system forms and maintains correct knowledge. Other systems use different terms for similar concepts (Hindsight calls atomic extractions “facts” and synthesized summaries “observations”; Mem0 uses “memories” for both layers without distinction), but the underlying two-layer pattern, extraction followed by aggregation, is shared. Intrinsic evaluation targets the fact layer, as this is the knowledge state that determines system behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用双层术语体系：观察是静态的、原子化的事实陈述，从单个实体中提取（并分类为决策、承诺或里程碑等类型），而事实则是系统随时间维持的动态合成知识单元。 观察一旦提取即不可更改；事实则是持久化的记忆，会随着新观察的到来而被创建、强化、更新或取代。 并非所有观察都会汇聚成事实：有些观察过于细致或短暂（例如一次性的行动项），孤立地评估观察只会衡量提取的完整性和原子性，而无法判断系统是否形成了正确的知识并持续维持。 其他系统对类似概念使用了不同术语（Hindsight 将原子化提取称为“事实”，将合成摘要称为“观察”；Mem0 则对两层都使用“记忆”一词并无区分），但其底层的双层模式——先提取后聚合——是共通的。 内在评估针对的是事实层，因为这一知识状态决定了系统的行为。

paragraphs.en: Each fact maintains a numeric confidence score (0–1), strengthened by +0.1 per reinforcing observation and adjustable by the LLM on create, update, or supersede decisions. A temporal guard prevents stale observations from overwriting newer knowledge: if an observation is older than the matched fact’s last update, update and supersede decisions are automatically downgraded to reinforce. Facts track a full chronological history (statement, confidence, change type, and trigger observation at each step), enabling intrinsic evaluation to inspect the complete evolution path. The system additionally tracks the number of distinct contributing authors per fact, counting unique contributors across supporting observations, which enables C6 (multi-author) evaluation. Retrieval uses hybrid search combining BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza 2009 ) keyword matching (weight 0.3) with k-NN vector similarity (weight 0.7) over 1024-dimensional embeddings. All LLM classification and synthesis calls use temperature 0 for deterministic outputs; remaining variance across runs comes from the embedding retrieval layer. The system runs on cloud-hosted LLM APIs for both extraction and synthesis (prompts and models in Appendices B , D ).

paragraphs.en: Across all 30 trajectories (Table 3 ), the mean absolute divergence between intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation is 0.168 ± 0.025 0.168\pm 0.025 (over 16 percentage points), with 44% of trajectories exceeding the τ = 0.15 \tau=0.15 threshold ( N = 11 N{=}11 runs). Using a stricter pass/fail criterion ( ≥ \geq 0.5 vs. < < 0.5), in 21 ± 4 21\pm 4 % of trajectories one evaluation method passes while the other fails, meaning a practitioner relying on extrinsic evaluation alone would reach the wrong conclusion about system correctness in roughly 1 out of 5 cases (Cohen’s κ = 0.118 \kappa=0.118 , barely above chance), confirming the two evaluation methods carry largely independent signal. A Pearson correlation between intrinsic and extrinsic scores across all 330 paired evaluations is r = 0.423 r=0.423 ( p < 10 − 15 p<10^{-15} ), so r 2 ≈ 0.18 r^{2}\approx 0.18 : only 18% of the variance in one score is explained by the other, 82% independent. The signed mean divergence is + 0.118 ± 0.029 +0.118\pm 0.029 , indicating intrinsic scores are systematically higher than extrinsic: the system’s memory is on average better than what QA evaluation reveals. A Wilcoxon signed-rank test over all 330 paired trajectory evaluations ( W = 4042 W=4042 , p < 10 − 16 p<10^{-16} ) confirms this divergence is statistically significant, establishing that the two evaluation methods measure fundamentally different properties of the system. C1 (LLM Compensation) shows the highest MAD ( 0.295 ± 0.084 0.295\pm 0.084 ): intrinsic scores 82.2% while extrinsic scores only 54.5%, confirming that memory quality is systematically underestimated by response-based evaluation. C5 (Temporal) and C6 (Multi-Author) show the lowest intrinsic scores (59.3% and 41.5%), identifying temporal evolution and source attribution as the hardest dimensions, yet extrinsic evaluation reports near-uniform scores across all categories, masking these weaknesses.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有 30 条轨迹（表 3）中，内在评估与外在评估之间的平均绝对差异为 0.168 ± 0.025（超过 16 个百分点），其中 44% 的轨迹超过了 τ = 0.15 的阈值（N = 11 次运行）。 采用更严格的通过/失败标准（≥ 0.5 对比 < 0.5），在 21 ± 4% 的轨迹中，一种评估方法通过而另一种则失败，这意味着仅依赖外在评估的实践者大约每 5 个案例中就会有 1 个得出关于系统正确性的错误结论（Cohen’s κ = 0.118，略高于随机水平），这证实了两种评估方法携带的信号基本独立。 在所有 330 对配对评估中，内在得分与外在得分之间的皮尔逊相关系数为 r = 0.423（p < 10⁻¹⁵），因此 r² ≈ 0.18：仅 18% 的一种得分的方差可由另一种得分解释，其余 82% 是独立的。 带符号的平均差异为 +0.118 ± 0.029，表明内在得分系统性地高于外在得分：系统的记忆能力平均而言优于 QA 评估所揭示的水平。 对所有 330 对配对轨迹评估进行的威尔科克森符号秩检验（W = 4042，p < 10⁻¹⁶）证实了这种差异具有统计学显著性，表明这两种评估方法测量的是系统截然不同的属性。 C1（LLM 补偿）显示出最高的 MAD（0.295 ± 0.084）：内在得分为 82.2%，而外在得分仅为 54.5%，证实了基于响应的评估系统性地低估了记忆质量。 C5（时间维度）和 C6（多作者）显示出最低的内在得分（分别为 59.3% 和 41.5%），表明时间演变和来源归属是最具挑战性的维度，而外在评估在所有类别中报告了近乎均匀的得分，掩盖了这些弱点。

At L1, intrinsic substantially exceeds extrinsic ( 68.0 ± 3.2 68.0\pm 3.2 vs. 50.9 ± 4.2 50.9\pm 4.2 ), meaning the system stores correct knowledge that retrieval fails to surface for QA. paragraphs.en: The intrinsic metrics directly identify which pipeline stage to improve: (1) classification accuracy is 20.1% overall, meaning the system rarely assigns the correct action label even when its fact state ends up partially correct; (2) multi-author source attribution (C6: 41.5%) does not adequately leverage author identity; (3) false updates (22.2%) indicate overly aggressive modification on reinforcement signals. None of these are recoverable from extrinsic scores.
paragraphs.zh: 内在指标直接指出了需要改进的哪个流程阶段：(1) 分类准确率总体为 20.1%，这意味着即使系统最终得出的事实状态部分正确，它也很少能分配正确的动作标签；(2) 多作者来源归因（C6: 41.5%）未能充分利用作者身份信息；(3) 错误更新（22.2%）表明对强化信号的修改过于激进。 这些内在问题都无法通过外在分数反映出来。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the intrinsic–extrinsic divergence is an artifact of a particular system implementation, corpus version, or backbone model, we evaluate four configurations spanning two factors: system configuration (simpler vs. main) and corpus (pre-release vs. the publicly released set), plus the main configuration with an upgraded backbone model. paragraphs.en: A key advantage of intrinsic evaluation is diagnostic decomposition : when a system fails, we can identify which pipeline stage is responsible:
paragraphs.zh: 内在评估的一个关键优势是诊断性分解：当系统发生故障时，我们可以确定具体是哪个流程阶段出了问题：

paragraphs.en: Extraction failures: Claims present in artifacts but not captured by the system’s observation layer.
paragraphs.zh: 提取失败：存在于人工制品中的主张未被系统的观察层捕获。

paragraphs.en: Synthesis failures: Claims extracted but incorrectly merged, duplicated, or lost during fact aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 合成失败：在事实聚合过程中，提取的陈述被错误合并、重复或丢失。

paragraphs.en: Update failures: State transitions missed or false updates applied.
paragraphs.zh: 更新失败：状态转换未执行或应用了错误的更新。

paragraphs.en: Conflict failures: Contradictions not detected or resolved incorrectly.
paragraphs.zh: 冲突失败：矛盾未被检测到或解决不正确。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 reveals three co-occurring failure patterns that intensify with difficulty. First, the claim miss rate rises from 58% at L1 to 88% at L3, indicating that subtle or embedded claims are increasingly lost during extraction. Second, fact count inflates from 9.1 to 20.7, showing the system fragments knowledge into many small, partially redundant facts rather than synthesizing them into coherent evolving beliefs. Third, classification accuracy degrades from 37% to 10%, meaning the system rarely identifies the correct action (create vs. update vs. reinforce) at higher difficulty. These three signals are mutually reinforcing: poor classification leads to creating new facts instead of updating existing ones (inflating count), which in turn fragments claims across facts (increasing miss rate on claim-level matching). None of these diagnostics are available from the extrinsic QA score, which remains flat at ∼ \sim 50% regardless of the underlying failure pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 表4揭示了三种共同出现的失败模式，这些模式会随着难度增加而加剧。 首先，断言漏检率从L1阶段的58%上升到L3阶段的88%，表明细微或隐含的断言在提取过程中越来越容易丢失。 其次，事实数量从9.1膨胀到20.7，这表明系统将知识碎片化为许多小型且部分冗余的事实，而非将其综合为连贯且不断演化的信念。 第三，分类准确率从37%下降至10%，这意味着在更高难度下，系统极少能识别出正确的操作（创建、更新或强化）。 这三种信号相互强化：分类效果差会导致系统创建新事实而非更新现有事实（从而增加事实数量），而这一过程又会将断言分散到多个事实中（导致断言层面匹配时的漏检率上升）。 这些诊断指标都无法通过外在的问答得分反映出来，该得分无论底层失败模式如何，始终稳定在约 \sim 50%。

paragraphs.en: Intrinsic evaluation does not replace extrinsic evaluation, it complements it. Extrinsic captures end-to-end utility as intrinsic enables diagnosis. A system scoring high on both is genuinely effective; high extrinsic but low intrinsic signals fragility (dependent on LLM compensation); high intrinsic but low extrinsic indicates a retrieval or generation bottleneck.
paragraphs.zh: 内在评估不能替代外在评估，而是对其的补充。 外在评估能反映端到端的效用，而内在评估则支持诊断分析。 在两项评估中均得分高的系统才是真正有效的；外在评估高但内在评估低则表明系统存在脆弱性（依赖大语言模型的补偿）；内在评估高但外在评估低则说明存在检索或生成瓶颈。

It does not evaluate episodic memory, procedural memory, or single-turn conversational recall, capabilities addressed by existing benchmarks. The benchmark contains 30 trajectories, sufficient for diagnostic evaluation but not for fine-grained statistical comparisons. Scoring relies on embedding similarity thresholds and LLM judges, introducing potential measurement noise.

paragraphs.en: We introduced FEB-30, the first benchmark designed for intrinsic evaluation of agent memory systems. By constructing trajectories where the expected memory state is known at every step, we demonstrated that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories showing meaningful disagreement, revealing false positives and false negatives invisible to response-based benchmarks. Diagnostic decomposition showed the system correctly classifies memory operations only 20% of the time (degrading from 34% at L1 to 10% at L3), a dimension extrinsic evaluation cannot measure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 FEB-30，这是首个专为智能体记忆系统的内在评估而设计的基准。 通过构建在每一步都已知预期记忆状态的轨迹，我们证明了内在评估与外在评估的平均差异为 16 个百分点，其中 44% 的轨迹显示出显著分歧，从而揭示了基于响应的基准无法检测到的假阳性和假阴性。 诊断性分解显示，该系统仅能在 20% 的情况下正确分类记忆操作（从 L1 阶段的 34% 下降至 L3 阶段的 10%），而这是外在评估无法测量的维度。

paragraphs.en: Intrinsic scoring inspects the fact store after each artifact is ingested. paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists all models used in the system under test and the evaluation scorer. paragraphs.en: To validate that our intrinsic metrics capture meaningful signal, we compute correlations between claim miss rate, intrinsic accuracy, and extrinsic accuracy across all 30 trajectories (using per-trajectory means across N = 11 N{=}11 runs).
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证我们的内在指标能否捕捉到有意义的信号，我们计算了所有 30 条轨迹中索赔漏检率、内在准确率和外在准确率之间的相关性（使用每条轨迹在 N = 11 次运行中的平均值）。

paragraphs.en: The strong negative correlation between miss rate and intrinsic accuracy ( r = − 0.84 r=-0.84 , p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ) validates that claim coverage is the primary driver of intrinsic scores. The weaker correlation between miss rate and extrinsic accuracy ( r = − 0.39 r=-0.39 ) confirms that extrinsic evaluation is less sensitive to extraction failures , consistent with LLM compensation masking missing claims at query time. The moderate positive correlation between intrinsic and extrinsic ( r = 0.55 r=0.55 ) shows they are related but far from equivalent, reinforcing the paper’s argument that both are needed.

paragraphs.en: Beyond these aggregate statistics, the paper’s category-level findings are also preserved under the upgraded backbone. Comparing per-category metrics between the main configuration and the upgraded backbone, the category rankings are highly stable: Spearman rank correlation across the six categories is ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94 for MAD, ρ = 0.89 \rho=0.89 for intrinsic accuracy, and ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94 for classification accuracy. The named extremes the paper relies on are unchanged: C1 (LLM Compensation) has the highest MAD and the highest classification accuracy, C6 (Multi-Author) has the lowest intrinsic accuracy, and C5 (Temporal) has the lowest classification accuracy, in both configurations. The only differences are adjacent swaps among already-close values, never a reordering of these extremes, indicating the diagnostic category structure is not an artifact of a particular backbone model.
